title: Portrait Staircase
what: Every voice VoiceStudio has on this PC, each saying a line in its own language: no recording, no upload, just a short list of tags (gender, age, pitch, accent) or an engine's built-in voice.

inputs.label: Voices
inputs.value: 75: 1 VoiceStudio's demo voice, 8 personality preset, 51 featured ready-made voice, 8 built-in voice of KittenTTS, 7 built-in voice of Supertonic 3

inputs.label: Languages
inputs.value: English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese

inputs.label: Left out
inputs.value: Community voices: their origins are unknown, and some may be real people

snippet:
import requests
r = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/generate", data={
    "text": TEXT,
    "language": "English",
    "instruct": "female, middle-aged, low pitch, british accent",
    "seed": 42,
})
open("take.wav", "wb").write(r.content)
snippet_openai:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(base_url="http://127.0.0.1:3900/v1", api_key="local")
audio = client.audio.speech.create(model="omnivoice", voice="VOICE_PROFILE_ID",
    input=TEXT,
    instructions="female, middle-aged, low pitch, british accent")
audio.write_to_file("take.mp3")
